title: Re-engagement & Motivation Intervention
description: Address declining participation and engagement through motivational strategies and structured check-ins.

actions.label: Personal Wellbeing Check-in
actions.description: Brief 1:1 with the teacher to understand barriers (personal, workload, interest).

actions.label: Micro-goal Setting
actions.description: Help student set a specific, achievable 2-week goal related to the course.

actions.label: Real-World Application Story
actions.description: Share a compelling real-world use case or industry story connecting the topic to a career outcome.

actions.label: Choice Board
actions.description: Offer a menu of 3 activities from which the student selects one to demonstrate understanding.
